_about: Capital market assumptions. Unlike every other parameter file here, no authority publishes the correct expected return. This set names its source and shows it on the face of any output built from it.

source.title: Horizon Actuarial Services, Survey of Capital Market Assumptions, 2026 Edition
source.detail: Exhibit 17, Average Survey Assumptions, page 16 of 20. Returns and standard deviations are the average across 43 investment advisors. The 10-year figures use all 43; the 20-year figures, recorded alongside, use the 29 who provided long-term assumptions, so the two horizons are not a like-for-like panel.

_verification.method: Exhibit 17 read from the published PDF and compared cell by cell against this file.
_verification.returnsAndVolatility: All 17 asset classes agree with the published 10-year geometric return and standard deviation, digit for digit.
_verification.correlations: All 153 lower-triangle cells agree with the published matrix, including the six negative entries printed in parentheses.
_verification.panel: 43 advisors in the 10-year panel, 29 in the 20-year panel, published August 2026.
_verification.surveyInflationNote: The survey's own inflation assumption is 2.44%. The house general inflation rate is 2.50%, which is a deliberate choice rather than a transcription of this survey. Holding expenses to the higher rate against nominal returns is the conservative direction.
_verification.unsplitClassesNote: These classes carry no sourced income split, so their whole return is modelled as appreciation. usSmallMidCap is the one that matters in practice: it appears in the sample allocations at 6 to 8 percent, and a small or mid cap index does pay a dividend, so a taxable account holding it is shown paying slightly less tax each year than it would. The others are not used in any current allocation. Sourcing a dividend yield for usSmallMidCap is the open item.

_spotYieldsForCrossCheck._note: Recorded as a sanity check on the survey, NOT as model inputs. Pairing a spot yield with a long-horizon expected return mixes two different measures.

threeMonthTreasuryParYield.source: US Treasury Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve
threeMonthTreasuryParYield.note: Coupon-equivalent. The discount-basis quote on the same day was 4.04%; the two conventions differ by 18 basis points and are not interchangeable.

tenYearTreasuryParYield.source: US Treasury Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve

iceBofaHighYieldToWorst.source: FRED series BAMLH0A0HYM2SYTW, ICE BofA US High Yield Index
iceBofaHighYieldToWorst.note: Yield to worst. The effective-yield series read 8.14% the same day; the two are different measures and must not be mixed across classes.

bloombergUsAggregate.source: iShares Core US Aggregate Bond ETF (AGG) average yield to maturity, standing in for the index
bloombergUsAggregate.note: Bloomberg gates index analytics, so this is the tracking fund rather than the index itself. The fund's 30-day SEC yield the same day was 5.05%.

_spotYieldsForCrossCheck._tension: Spot bond yields currently sit ABOVE the survey's ten-year expected returns for the same classes. That is a real feature of the present market, not an error in either source, and it is the reason spot yields are not used as the interest component.

usLargeCap._dividendSource: S&P 500 dividend yield, Nareit REITWatch September 2026, data as of 2026-08-31
usLargeCap._capitalGainSource: Broad US equity index funds and ETFs distributed no realised capital gain in the December 2025 cycle (Vanguard year-end distribution table, VTSAX / VTI / VFIAX / VOO all 0.00%). Appreciation is therefore the remainder and is taxed only on sale.
usLargeCap.source: Horizon Actuarial Services, Survey of Capital Market Assumptions, 2026 Edition, Exhibit 17, verified against the published PDF on 2026-10-27.

usSmallMidCap._warning: No published income yield was found for this class, so the whole return sits in appreciation. That understates the tax this class throws off. Do not use it in a taxable account projection until the split is sourced.
usSmallMidCap.source: Horizon Actuarial Services, Survey of Capital Market Assumptions, 2026 Edition, Exhibit 17, verified against the published PDF on 2026-10-27.
usSmallMidCap._incomeSplit: Not split. The survey publishes a total return only, and no sourced income breakdown has been recorded for this class, so the whole return is treated as appreciation and taxed on sale. In a taxable account this understates the tax due each year.
